# The Inspector's Git panel through its own controls (tests/run.sh puts a
# scratch repository at @REPO@: Sources/a.swift modified, Sources/new.swift
# new). The pane sits in a folder *inside* the repository, where git's
# paths — always from the root — and the pane's own differ.
type:cd @REPO@/Sources
key:enter
wait:1.0
key:cmd+alt+i
wait:2.0
click:Stage a.swift
wait:1.5
click:Commit message
type:from the panel
key:enter
wait:2.0
# The terminal reads back what the panel did (once it has the keyboard
# back from the message field). The brackets come from git's own format:
# text typed into the wrong place can't pass for the commit.
click:400,300
type:git log --format='[%s]' | cat; git status --porcelain | cat
key:enter
wait:1.0
expect:[from the panel]
expect:?? Sources/new.swift
expect-not: M Sources/a.swift
# A new file's diff is against nothing, not an empty page.
click:new.swift
wait:2.0
shot:git-panel.png
